parts:
Hi, 

Some of the vocabulary you use sounds a bit strange (e.g., "generate a path"), but perhaps you are new to SEM?  SEMNET is a forum for asking general questions about SEM

http://www2.gsu.edu/~mkteer/semnet.html

Once you figure out what it is that you want to do (or what the usual terms are in the SEM literature), you can learn how to use lavaan to do it, and this would be the appropriate forum for getting help when you can't figure out this particular software.  But you can start by reading the tutorial pages (http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/index.html) and the paper (https://www.jstatsoft.org/article/view/v048i02).

Good luck,

Terry
